# foundry_memory_store (Data Source)

~> **Preview:** This data source requires `enable_preview = ["memory_stores"]` on the provider. Preview features may change or be removed in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

Looks up the current memory store object by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foundry_memory_store" "agent_memory" {
  name = "agent-memory"
}

output "agent_memory_updated_at" {
  value = data.foundry_memory_store.agent_memory.updated_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the memory store to look up.

### Read-Only

- `chat_model` (String) Chat completion model deployment used for memory processing.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the memory store was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the memory store.
- `embedding_model` (String) Embedding model deployment used for memory processing.
- `id` (String) Service-assigned memory store identifier.
- `kind` (String) Memory store definition kind. This data source currently accepts `default`.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Key-value metadata attached to the memory store.
- `object` (String) Object discriminator, always `memory_store`.
- `options` (Attributes) Options for the default memory store implementation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--options))
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the memory store was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options`

Read-Only:

- `chat_summary_enabled` (Boolean) Whether chat summary extraction is enabled.
- `default_ttl_seconds` (Number) Default memory time-to-live in seconds.
- `procedural_memory_enabled` (Boolean) Whether procedural memory extraction is enabled.
- `user_profile_details` (String) User profile categories to extract.
- `user_profile_enabled` (Boolean) Whether user profile extraction is enabled.
